title: 树冠会降温吗：一个好问题如何被证据层拆开
central_argument: A bounded observational association can remain useful when canopy, surface temperature, near-ground air temperature and human heat exposure are kept distinct and a broader causal tree-planting sentence is refused.
claim_ceiling: Named observational materials support a bounded canopy/near-ground-air-temperature association only; no universal causal tree-planting effect, human heat-stress conclusion or Pointfire external validation is inferred.
